highlights.title: A new Contacts page
highlights.text: Requests sit above your friends, Find people searches everyone on Whisprl, and a QR code shares your profile.

highlights.title: Requests with a note
highlights.text: Say who you are when you add someone. The note is end-to-end encrypted and opens your chat once they accept.

highlights.title: Birthdays
highlights.text: Friends see the day and month, never the year, with Birthdays this week in Contacts. Hide yours in Settings any time.

highlights.title: Settings in sections
highlights.text: Your profile, appearance, chats, privacy and security each have a page of their own, on a computer and a phone.
